Follow An early fall nor’easter is gathering strength along the central East Coast, pounding beaches in several states with heavy surf and threatening to bring coastal flooding, wind and rain to parts of the Northeast through the weekend. ⛈️ ️ In the areas at risk? Track the storm, find out your local risk and get more detailed timing from meteorologists in the CNN Weather app ⛈️ The nor’easter, named for the direction its punishing winds come from, currently sits several hundred miles off the Mid-Atlantic coast and will begin to track north and strengthen over the next two days. More than 40 million people will feel the impacts from the nor’easter from now through the weekend, from either wind, rain, coastal flooding or some combination of those. Areas from Boston to the New York City metro will start to feel the effects of the storm’s biggest punch of wind-driven rain and coastal flooding by late Friday or early Saturday.
